claim: R6-07 puts "and under no disaster look" on every "never decayed ⇒ unchanged" statement (item 122 (d)). The round wrote the condition on the building subject of UE33's E1 (l. 2435) and on T-V4-82 (g)'s never-decayed control (l. 3175). It did not write it on their second subject: E1's "an underground none of whose buildings has decayed" and (g)'s "every band of an underground with no decayed building", each said to draw (and export) byte-identically. Under a look, a storey below 0 reads its building's drawn level, the higher of its own and the look's (J-V4.130; V04 §5.6 (6): "the look over a storey below 0 with V03 §5.6 (4)'s"). T-V4-82 (i) draws a never-decayed church's crypt at the look's level. So such an underground is not byte-identical while a look stands over it. T-V4-82 (i) runs the look, and (g)'s fixture holds none, so nothing built or tested changes.
required_change: UE33's E1: "and an underground none of whose buildings has decayed, draw byte-identically" → "and an underground none of whose buildings has decayed or stands under a disaster look, draw byte-identically". T-V4-82 (g): "and every band of an underground with no decayed building draw and export byte-identically" → "and every band of an underground with no decayed building and none under a disaster look draw and export byte-identically".
